body.name: Heterogeneous weighted-erasure posterior-spread handle
body.construction: Start from the explicit family \((Q_t:t\in\mathcal T_{\mathrm{tilt}})\), use the separation \(\tau_t=t\sqrt S/2\), control random weighted information and the two posterior tails of \(T(V)\) conditional on \(O\), and apply an interval-coverage averaging inequality to \(\Lambda(O,R)\) under the same joint laws.
